$description: Blank design spec. Copy this file to <slug>.spec.json and fill every TODO. Keys starting with $ are guidance for the person or agent filling it; delete them once a value is in place. Order matters: fill top to bottom, because later layers reference earlier ones with {path.to.token}.

meta.name: TODO: product or site name
meta.slug: TODO: kebab-case id, also the file name

source.repo: TODO: URL or null for a net-new site
source.tokensFile: TODO: where the CSS variables live, or null
source.prose: TODO: any human-written style guide this was drawn from

meta.modeSwitch: TODO: how a page enters each mode (class, attribute, media query)

skins.contract: Optional. How another system can restyle this one by remapping the role layer.

identity.$description: Why this system looks the way it does. An agent reads this before choosing anything the tokens don't cover.
identity.thesis: TODO: one or two sentences. What it is, who it serves, what it feels like.
invariants: TODO: 3–6 statements that stay true on every page (type pairing, where the accent may appear, how things move).
identity.identityTest: TODO: the check that tells you a page still belongs to this system after the palette changes.

tokens.$description: DTCG-style values. Brand tokens are raw values; role tokens are what components use, with one value per mode. Reference another token as {color.brand.name}.

brand.$description: 3–7 raw colors. Give each a human name and a one-line use. Nothing else in the system is a raw color.

role.$description: Required roles. Add more, never fewer. Each role has a value per mode in meta.modes.

gradient.$description: Optional. Named gradients built only from brand tokens.

family.$description: Three to four roles. Name the source so an agent can load it.

scale.$description: Every size the system uses, by name. Each step says family, weight and, for labels, case and tracking.

space.$description: A base unit and its steps, in rem, each with a use.

radius.$description: Named radii, each with what gets it.

shadow.$description: Elevation steps plus the focus ring. Per-mode where they differ.

hover.$description: The transform each kind of element gets on hover.

components.$description: One entry per reusable element. Values reference tokens. `wireframe` tells a low-fi tool how to draw it without any styling.

TODO-component.purpose: TODO: the job it does, in one sentence
anatomy: TODO: named parts, in reading order; suffix ? if optional

wireframe.shape: box | pill | chip | row | square | line-short | dashed-border
wireframe.label: TODO

patterns.$description: Page-level layouts as named grid areas. A wireframe tool draws `grid.areas` directly; a developer turns them into grid-template-areas.

voice.summary: TODO: how the product talks, in two sentences

rules.rule: Components take every color, font and shadow from a token.
rules.check: No literal colors outside the token block

rules.rule: Every interactive element shows the focus ring.
Body text ≥ 4.5:1, large text ≥ 3:1, in every mode.

contrast.$description: Every text/background pair the system actually uses, measured, per mode.

knownIssues.$description: When extracting from an existing site, record drift here instead of silently fixing it in the spec.

acceptance: TODO: the checks an agent runs on its own output before handing it back
